dispute.claim_text: He would not stop asking me to change the route, three or four times, 'too many red lights, too many red lights'. I finally pressed accept just to make him stop. Then the new route said expressway with ERP and he didn't even take the expressway! I got charged for the toll anyway. If he wanted more money he shouldn't have taken the job.

counterparty_statement.text: The passenger accepted the route change in the app; it's recorded. Traffic on the expressway then got bad so I used local roads to be faster for her. The fare is whatever the app calculated after she accepted.
